name: sun_blessed_healer_kicked_offers_cheap_nonland_permanents
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Seat 0 casts Sun-Blessed Healer kicked. Its graveyard holds a mana value 3 creature card, a Forest (a land), a mana value 2 artifact card, a sorcery card and a mana value 1 enchantment card; seat 1's graveyard a mana value 1 creature card. The trigger's target ask offers the artifact and the enchantment only. The step stops at that ask (no decision word), so it pins its vocabulary.
